The remaining exterior pairs are (top2,top3) and (bottom1,bottom2). Thus CT changes to TC on top and the lower cup remains (1,2), exactly proof step 2.1.

The trace arrow denotes replacement of a stack by its exterior matching, not an extra morphism or a strand; vertical reflection yields right multiplication for the bottom exchange.
